text_block_list.text:
Hearing strange voices from behind the 
school building, I went over to 
investigate...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nya-nya-nya! Nyan-nyan-nya! Unya~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looking good, looking good! You've 
gotten a lot better~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san. Actually, I was just 
giving Spe-chan a quick lesson in Cat 
Language.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I came over because I heard strange 
noises. You're certainly doing something 
bizarre."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove-san. Are you interested by 
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Absurd. In the first place, there is no 
way cats possess a linguistic system like 
humans.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oho, so you think it's impossible? In 
that case, shall I give you a 
demonstration?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan. Since you're here, why not try 
out the cat greeting I just taught you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Umm... ...Meow~

text_block_list.name: Lounging Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Mnya.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Sei-chan, I did it! They replied to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...They're likely just exchanging simple 
calls. I doubt it's complex enough to be 
called a language.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho. Then you can do it too, right, Air 
Groove-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Nyaa~!

However... the moment the cat heard Air 
Groove's voice, it ran away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?!

Afterward, Air Groove tried a few more 
times, but... the cat ran away every 
single time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! Why?! Why does the cat ignore only 
me...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, your pronunciation is a bit 
problematic. Pardon my bluntness, but are 
you taking this lightly as mere animal 
imitation?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Are you implying that I am taking 
this lightly? I cannot simply overlook 
such an insult!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was just so unexpected. Who 
would've thought the vice president would 
stumble over her greeting...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, if Air Groove-san got serious about 
it, she'd probably end up doing it way 
better than me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Allow me to show you what 
the 'Empress' is truly made of.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I can't wait~! Please give us lots 
of meows!
choice_data_list: I want to see Seiun Sky go all out too
Why not teach them the basics first?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If you claim that Cat Language 
truly exists, then why don't you 
demonstrate it for me first?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Guess there's no helping it, nya. 
...Ahem, *cough cough*.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Meow-meow-meow. Nya~ nya~. Meow-meow?

text_block_list.name: Sleeping Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Mnya. Nya nya. Nya nya~ nya nya nya.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What did you say?! Are you telling 
me you can actually understand each 
other?!

Seiun Sky displayed cat-speaking skills 
far beyond expectations. Though amazed, 
everyone watched on, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Unyaa~ unyaa~! Nyahaha! Nya nya nya. 
Nyaa~ nyaa~..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Sei-chan? Maybe it's time to 
st—... are you listening?

Just then, the cat that had been chatting 
with Seiun Sky suddenly stood up and 
dashed off...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-eeen!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: H-Hey!? Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-Sei-chaaan!? Did you turn into a real 
cat!?

—Afterwards, when Seiun Sky returned, she 
said, "I don't remember a thing, but I 
feel like I got an insane workout..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There, there, let me explain then. First, 
don't make eye contact with the kitty. You 
have to show that you mean no harm.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Once you can do that, it's time to greet 
them. Say your greeting in a gentle 
voice... Meow~

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: M... Meow~.

text_block_list.name: Fat Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Meow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! It replied to me!

Even after that, with Seiun Sky's 
assistance, Air Groove awkwardly continued 
her dialogue with the cat...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to that, we achieved a decent 
amount of results. It was quite 
fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still. As for me, I cannot definitively 
say that cat language exists, however.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh dear? You still don't acknowledge it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'll admit it. Your powers of 
observation and understanding, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Sensing the cat's mood and calling out in 
just the right tone. Being able to 
communicate emotionally with a cat to that 
extent is truly an astonishing ability."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I can't reach a conclusion today, but... 
this is quite intriguing. The theme of cat 
language, that is."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Sei-chan, you got praised!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I really wanted to get them to say, 
"Cat language exists," meow. Well, still 
pretty good results~♪
